rules.title: Missing Record ID
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if record_id missing or blank.
rules.recommended_resolution: Assign immutable KR-NNNNNN before submit.

rules.title: Duplicate Record ID
rules.description: Two artifacts claim the same KR-* identity.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if record_id appears more than once in record_index/canon_manifest.
rules.recommended_resolution: Keep one record; deprecate or re-ID the duplicate (never remap meaning of existing KR-*).

rules.title: Missing Canonical Definition
rules.recommended_resolution: Write a single Canonical Definition with scope.

rules.title: Invalid Record ID Pattern
rules.recommended_resolution: Use zero-padded KR-NNNNNN form.

rules.title: Missing Canonical Name
rules.recommended_resolution: Set unique Canonical Name per concept.

rules.title: Missing Version
rules.recommended_resolution: Set MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.

rules.title: Invalid Version Format
rules.recommended_resolution: Correct to SemVer.

rules.title: Missing Required Status
rules.description: identity.status missing or not in allowed enum.
rules.recommended_resolution: Set allowed lifecycle status.

rules.title: Missing Required Sections
rules.description: One or more mandatory KR schema top-level sections missing.
rules.recommended_resolution: Complete all mandatory sections per standards KR schema / template.

rules.title: Missing Required Summary Scope
rules.description: canonical_definition.scope is missing (required summary of coverage).
rules.recommended_resolution: Add Scope describing what the record covers.

rules.title: Missing Required References
rules.recommended_resolution: Cite ≥1 existing SRC-* or mark pending with TODO_REVIEW policy exception documented.

rules.title: Unresolved Placeholder Tokens
rules.recommended_resolution: Replace placeholders or convert to TODO_REVIEW notes.

rules.title: Missing Vietnamese Name
rules.description: vietnamese_name required for classical BaZi foundational records when language policy requires it.
rules.detection_rule: WARN if vietnamese_name blank and discipline=Bazi foundational.
rules.recommended_resolution: Fill Vietnamese Name or document waiver.

rules.title: Missing Classification Pack/Module
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if pack_id or module_id blank.
rules.recommended_resolution: Assign Pack and Module IDs from package registry.

rules.title: Missing Knowledge Type
rules.recommended_resolution: Set Foundational Concept / Entity / Rule / etc.

rules.title: Multiple Canonical Definitions
rules.description: More than one competing canonical definition block in one record.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if multiple primary definition fields/sections detected.
rules.recommended_resolution: Keep a single definition string; move alternatives to notes/assertions.

rules.title: Duplicate Definition Across Records
rules.description: Near-identical Canonical Definition used by two active KR-*.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if normalized definition hash collides across non-deprecated records.
rules.recommended_resolution: Merge concepts or differentiate definitions; deprecate duplicate.

rules.title: Definition Conflict With Assertion
rules.detection_rule: FAIL on contradictory high-confidence assertions vs definition without conflict notes.
rules.recommended_resolution: Reconcile text, lower confidence, or add CONFLICTS_WITH / conflict notes.

rules.title: Definition Missing Out Of Scope
rules.description: Out of scope not provided for foundational records.
rules.detection_rule: WARN if out_of_scope blank for Foundational Concept.
rules.recommended_resolution: State what the record deliberately does not answer.

rules.title: Invented Source Citation
rules.description: primary/secondary source_id not present in bibliography SSOT.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if SRC-* not found in bibliography registry.
rules.recommended_resolution: Use real SRC-* or remove claim; never invent sources.

rules.title: Assertion Missing Source IDs
rules.description: Assertion lacks source_ids array or it is empty.
rules.recommended_resolution: Attach ≥1 SRC-* or mark assertion pending_review with TODO_REVIEW.

rules.title: High Confidence With TODO_REVIEW
rules.description: Assertion confidence=high while TODO_REVIEW remains open on that claim.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if confidence=high and linked TODO_REVIEW present.
rules.recommended_resolution: Lower confidence or resolve TODO_REVIEW before release.

rules.title: Missing Characteristics Container
rules.recommended_resolution: Add characteristic key/value items or document N/A.

rules.title: Record ID Mutation Detected
rules.description: Attempt to change an already published record_id.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if published record_id differs from immutable registry binding.
rules.recommended_resolution: Never remap; create new KR-* and deprecate old.

rules.title: Missing Validation Block
rules.recommended_resolution: Populate validation section per KR schema.
